name: game-sprint-plan
description: Invoke when the user needs to plan a development sprint, break down tasks, schedule game work, or organize a sprint with cross-discipline dependencies. Triggers on: "sprint plan", "task breakdown", "development planning", "scheduling", "sprint backlog". Do NOT invoke for scope evaluation (use game-scope-check) or retrospectives (use game-retrospective). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.
